title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tia and Tamera are caught in the middle when Ray and Lisa square off over Lisa's decision to let the twins "play hooky" from school.

description:

When Tia's out sick from school, Tamera befriends a new girl who becomes obsessed with looking and acting like the twins.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Lisa gets "cold feet" after Terrence pops the question, while the twins worry that Lisa's marriage means they'll stop living under the same roof.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tia rearranges her class schedule in order to spend more time with the school "stud"; Tamera is tapped to pitch a big softball game.

title: The Game
description:

Melanie musters the courage to reveal the mistaken DNA test results of Baby DJ, further driving a wedge in her marriage and sending Janay on the warpath.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E4 — The Wing King
Malik continues his downward sprial of behavior, culminating in a drunken rage and assault against a police officer. He is arrested.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E5 — It Was All Good Just A Week Ago
After assaulting a police offcer and getting a DUI, Malik is assured by his people that he is not going to jail. He later learns that the Saber's owner is filling him with a false sense of security in order to kick him off the team.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E6 — Men In Crisis
Uh oh! More trouble in paradise for Derwin and Melanie. Derwin, trying to avoid conflict with Melanie, keeps his reconciliation with Janay a secret, only to have it backfire when he sends Janay mixed signals about their relationship.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E7 — Don't You Know Who I Was?
Malik, frustrated with rehab and convinced that he has no problems or addictions, leaves to attend a Sabers' party only to run into Jason and Derwin, who confront him about his reckless behavior and send him back to rehab to face his problems head-on.

title: The Game
description:
S4 E8 — You Say Goodbye, I Say Hello
When Kelly learns that her role on the reality show is in jeopardy, she goes to extreme measures to stay relevant, which ultimately backfires with daughter Brittany and forces Kelley to re-evaluate her future in San Diego.

title: The Wayans Bros.

Shawn and Marlon find a baby on their doorstep--and one of them might be its father!

description:

Everyone wants to split the huge stash of money they find in the building, but the owner may still come get it.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:

Shawn and Marlon play a Halloween prank on Pops, but when terrible things begin to happen around the building, they wonder if they offended an evil spirit.
